version.description: DESC-9. A single integer; there is no minor version. DESC-29 makes it count breaking changes to this Capability's own surface alone.

address.title: Address
address.description: DESC-36. An absolute https URL — or http on a loopback host, where no network path exists to read a credential on — or a relative reference resolved against the Descriptor's own URL. DESC-13 governs whether a credential may be sent to one that is off-origin.

answers.description: QRY-1. Every Query the Worker answers, keyed by name. A Query not here is `404` under QRY-6. The key carries no pattern: it travels as the VALUE of the `query` parameter and is percent-encoded like any other.

title: Queries capability entry
description: QRY-1. The shared Capability entry with the address required, and the Queries this Worker answers. The Descriptor is the catalog: the surface answers and never lists what exists.
